CheckSpec.description:
A validation check executed inside a sandbox.

``run`` is either a shell command string (executed with ``/bin/sh -lc``)
or an argv list.  The remaining fields are optional refinements used by the
validation runner (plan 09).  Checks are always executed in a *fresh*
validation container; nothing here can cause the agent's container or
environment to be reused.

are inserted/updated by key and ``remove_keys`` are deleted.

schema.title: Response List Events V1 Projects  Project Id  Events Get

get.description:
Poll the append-only event log and stream new rows as SSE.

``once=true`` is a test/tooling convenience: existing events are emitted and
the stream closes.  The default keeps the connection open until the client
disconnects.

schema.title: Response List Plans V1 Projects  Project Id  Plans Get

post.description:
Generate the next plan version.

Analysis is idempotent and is run automatically for a freshly submitted
project so that the documented ``submit -> plan`` flow works without a
separate call.

get.description: Return a read-only, deterministic report of the current DB state.

schema.title: Response List Project Tasks V1 Projects  Project Id  Tasks Get

post.description:
Re-open a BLOCKED task through the audited transition function.

``FAILED`` is terminal in the authoritative 00 §7 state machine; the API
refuses to bypass that gate and requires a replan instead.  ``reset_budget``
is explicit because it changes policy-derived retry accounting.
